oracle.description: docs/plans/agentops/2026-08-23-handoff-loop-and-telemetry.md T-1/T-3/T-4/T-5 declare every field and sink; coordinator-authored tests in templates/dispatch/hooks/tests decide correctness.

purpose: Extend the session-cost Stop hook with turns/assistant_msgs/tool_calls/duration_s, add a PostToolUse gate log, drain it to auditctl as workflow.session, and add the /friction skill. No field may be renamed or dropped: the cockpit reads the existing record shape.
required_outcomes: log-session-cost.sh emits turns, assistant_msgs, tool_calls and duration_s in addition to every field it emits today
an existing cost row parses unchanged and the cockpit cost summary still renders

a PostToolUse hook matching pytest, run_round_checks, hybrid_dispatch gate and cargo test appends {ts, cmd, exit, signal, ok} to $AGENTOPS_GATE_LOG_DIR/gates-<session>.jsonl, where signal names which evidence decided the verdict

the Stop hook drains gates.jsonl into auditctl add --type workflow.session --source claude-hook --actor claude-hook with metadata {session, turns, cost_usd, gates[], rework_rounds} (auditctl requires --actor and --summary and rejects a session: ref)
rework_rounds counts a red gate followed by a retry of the same command
a /friction skill records auditctl add --type workflow.friction --summary "<note>"
no hook fails the session when auditctl is absent from PATH

acceptance_properties.requirement: the cost record stays backward compatible
acceptance_properties.fails_when: an existing field is renamed, removed, or changes type, or a pre-change row fails to parse

acceptance_properties.requirement: the new counters are derived from the transcript, not from the Stop payload
acceptance_properties.fails_when: turns, assistant_msgs or tool_calls read a key the Stop event does not carry, or are hardcoded to 0

acceptance_properties.requirement: gate outcomes reach auditctl exactly once per session
acceptance_properties.fails_when: gates.jsonl is not drained, is drained twice, or survives into the next session

acceptance_properties.requirement: rework_rounds distinguishes a retry from a first attempt
acceptance_properties.fails_when: a single red gate with no retry counts as rework, or a retried red gate counts as zero
the Stop hook exits non-zero or loses the cost row when auditctl is not on PATH

non_goals: registering the Stop hook in any repo (T-2, done by hand outside this packet)
any OTel or Alloy receiver (deferred, pathway E4.4)
editing hybrid_dispatch.py, the manifest schema, or any dispatch policy
